# Closure

Source: [`Kernel/Closure.wl`](../../Kernel/Closure.wl) · Design notes: [MODULES.md](../MODULES.md#closure-kernelclosurewl--checkclosure)

CheckClosure: decide, monomial by monomial, whether the integrated flows close on the ansatz. Protected, DeclaredNumeric and Causality flows must vanish (else abort with the tag's reason); Neglected flows are reported with their value at one valid random point; every declared monomial becomes an equation d\_s(combination) = RHS. Objective, assumptions and checks: docs/MODULES.md section "Closure".

## Symbols

### `CheckClosure`

`CheckClosure[integrated, symmetries]` asserts that every Protected, DeclaredNumeric and Causality flow vanishes, warns about every Neglected flow with its value at a valid random point, and turns every declared monomial with Gamma\_k coefficient norm \* comb (norm the pure number) into the equation d\_s(comb) = Value / norm. Returns the "Closure" stage.

### `ShowClosureReport`

`ShowClosureReport[closure]` prints, for every monomial, its class and the outcome of the closure check.
